group.title: Outdoor unit (compressor group)
group.description: One config entry per outdoor unit. The group_id is permanent — pick a short identifier you'll recognise (lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores).

compat.title: Compressor compatibility
compat.description: By default the integration treats heat ↔ cool and heat ↔ fan_only as physically incompatible (the loser is blocked). Add one extra incompatible pair below if your hardware needs it; you can configure more by editing the entry's YAML later.

zone_basic.title: Zone basics
zone_basic.description: Each zone wraps one upstream mini-split head with sensor fusion, safety, and arbitration. Pick a short zone_id and point it at the upstream climate entity that the integration should command.

data.name: Friendly name
data.always_assert_head_state: Re-issue commands to the head every tick (advanced — may cause IR remote heads to beep)

zone_fusion.title: Sensor fusion
zone_fusion.description:
How readings from the upstream head's built-in sensor and any room sensors are combined into the value used for control.

Most mini-split heads do not ship a usable humidity reading, so the humidity field below picks a *room* hygrometer (the same role the room temperature sensor plays for temperature). Future versions may grow head/room humidity blending; for now anything you pick is treated as a room sensor.

data.head_temp_sensor: Head temperature source (climate entity or sensor)

zone_safety.title: Safety floor & ceiling
zone_safety.description: Hard limits enforced regardless of user intent. If the room drops below the floor the integration forces HEAT; above the ceiling, COOL. Leave blank to skip.

zone_advanced_menu.title: Optional zone features
zone_advanced_menu.description:
{configured}

Pick a section to configure, or choose 'done' to finish this zone.

zone_occupancy.title: Occupancy
zone_occupancy.description: Tie this zone to an occupancy signal so the integration can apply setback when the space is empty.

data.linger_minutes: Treat the zone as 'recent' for this many minutes after it goes unoccupied

zone_setback.title: Setback offsets
zone_setback.description: How far the active setpoint moves away from the comfort target when the zone is unoccupied.

zone_fan.title: Ceiling fan
zone_fan.description: Optional coordinated ceiling-fan dispatch. The fan helps shave a small comfort credit off the deviation when running.

data.enabled: Enable fan dispatch for this zone
data.lockout_entity_id: Lockout entity (binary_sensor or input_boolean — prevents the fan from running while ON)

zone_aux.title: Auxiliary heat
zone_aux.description: Optional resistive heater used transparently when the head can't keep up (cold-weather lockout, head fault, or near-floor safety). Hidden from the managed climate entity.

data.enabled: Enable aux heat for this zone
data.outdoor_lockout_temp: Outdoor lockout temperature (°C — aux engages at/below this)
